svg.title: VDAT workflow with vulnerability calculation and data filtering
svg.desc: Inventory: left dashed Natural Data frame contains three natural sample photos and ellipsis; central rounded VDAT frame contains adversarial perturbation noise image, perturbation sketch, vulnerability calculation module, vulnerability-of-samples row, data filtering module, natural/adversarial small outputs, downward training arrow and neural-network icon; right top green dashed frame contains margin sketch, hard-margin delta stack, soft-margin transformation and vulnerability formula; right bottom blue dashed frame contains V-theta and P-theta lists, probability calculation, conditions with random threshold, noise thumbnail, and natural/adversarial training sample outputs. Main symmetry/equipartition basis: panels are horizontally aligned workflow blocks, with top-right and bottom-right sections stacked and sharing the same left/right extents.

g.desc: Origin is the upper bird photo; content proceeds downward through bear photo, ellipsis, market photo, then bottom label. Images are natural-data examples aligned on a vertical center line.

Origin is adversarial perturbation noise patch near the upper left of the central frame. Flow moves right to perturbation geometry and vulnerability calculation, then downward to sample vulnerability and data filtering, ending at natural/adversarial training and VDAT network. The section is a left-to-right pipeline with a lower branch.

Origin is the left margin sketch. Flow goes right through delta margins, hard-margin label, soft-margin transformation, down arrow, formula strip, then bottom section label. The diagram uses a horizontal symmetry basis with three parallel margin arrows.

Origin is the V-theta list at left. Flow moves right to probability calculation and P-theta list, then branches to two threshold conditions leading to natural and adversarial training samples. The two output boxes are vertically paired with shared left alignment.

Confirmed mapping: Natural Data top bird, bear, and market objects in original figure correspond to constructed drafts and SAM assets P010/P007/P008. Outer dashed frame, ellipsis, and label are retained.

Confirmed mapping: the three Vulnerability of Samples thumbnails correspond to SAM assets P003/P001/P004 at their original source crop coordinates; surrounding rounded peach frame and numeric labels are retained.
Confirmed mapping: the small natural and adversarial output thumbnails after Data Filtering correspond to SAM assets P006 and P005; text labels Nat/Adv Train remain native SVG.
Confirmed mapping: central adversarial perturbation noise patch corresponds to SAM asset P011. Text and workflow arrows are retained.
